name: The Martyrdom of the Vanguard: The Fall of Heroes and the Blinding Light

cycle_advancement.world_state: The Tragic Apotheosis: Command Staff Slain in Glorious Martyrdom

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The blood of martyrs soaks the Dread Citadel. Sergeant Vane, Bone 'ead Bragg, Trooper Jax, and Enginseer Kroll have fallen in battle. Their bodies lie around the cracked throne, but their final plasma detonation tore Malgakor down to 5,068 HP as the Kastelan Automaton stands alone, fists raised in silent, immortal vengeance.

completed_milestones.title: The Glorious Martyrdom of Sergeant Kathryn Vane and the Strike Team
completed_milestones.consequence: Sergeant Kathryn Vane led an unyielding suicidal charge into the heart of the Dread Citadel: despite taking lethal strikes and falling with Bragg, Jax, and Kroll, their sacrificial plasma volleys tore 2,230 damage from Lord Malgakor (reducing him to 5,068 HP), breaking his daemonic invulnerability.

new_decision.decision: Charged directly into Malgakor's flaming soul-blade, driving her screaming Mk VII Chainsword deep into his cracked throat-seal while bellowing 'FOR THE EMPEROR!' before being struck down by the dark god's counter-cleave.
new_decision.impact: Fell in glorious combat (Vitality 5 -> 0, KIA). Slashed the Chaos Lord's vital arteries, enabling the final downfall of the beast.

new_decision.decision: Roared 'NO HURT DA SARGE!' and tackled Malgakor's waist, detonating his Power Fist point-blank inside the Chaos Lord's torso before being cleaved by the descending blade.
new_decision.impact: Fell in glorious combat (Vitality 5 -> 0, KIA), fracturing Malgakor's spine.

new_decision.decision: Overcharged his Mark IV Plasma Gun to maximum reactor overload, shoving the glowing barrel into Malgakor's faceplate and pulling the trigger in a blinding sun-fire blast.
new_decision.impact: Fell in glorious combat (Vitality 5 -> 0, KIA), vaporizing Malgakor's helmet and blinding the Chaos God.

new_decision.decision: Buried his Omnissian Power Axe into the Citadel's core logic conduit, discharging sacred binary lightning through Malgakor's cybernetics before collapsing into the scrap slag.
new_decision.impact: Fell in glorious combat (Vitality 5 -> 0, KIA), transferring primary command override of the Kastelan Automaton to the garrison.
